options: A. Move the rooks pawns (a-pawn and h-pawn) forward two squares, bring the queen out on move two to chase edge pawns.
B. Contest the central squares (d4, d5, e4, e5) with pawns.
C. Advance the king up the board on move three to lead the attack before moving any knights or bishops off the back rank.
D. Move every pawn forward one square across all eight files before developing a single minor piece.

quiz_item.correct_answer: B. Contest the central squares (d4, d5, e4, e5) with pawns.
